summary: PLDT Inc., a Philippine foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE and PSE, furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026 attaching its PSE/SEC disclosure letter and press release announcing PwC's appointment as the company's new external auditor, following the prior Form 4-9 and Form 17-C filings on November 2, 2026. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or transaction dates were disclosed. The filing is a routine auditor change reported under PSE Disclosure Rules and Section 17.1 of the Philippine Securities Regulation Code; no board recommendation on a transaction or advisor mandate appears. No deal terms apply; not a special situation, so no risk-arb angle exists.
